description: Released WGS Extract v44.2 versus the current CLI: each case's v44.2 behaviour (release source citation), current behaviour, relation (parity, correction, policy or known-gap) and evidence. tests/test_v4_differential.py checks every case that has expected outputs; scripts/v4_differential_corpus.py runs the evidence and the public HG00096 comparison. See docs/migrating-from-v4.md.

development_repository.note: Stale v33-era tree; not the released program.

pins.tools_note: Both sides ran the same modern samtools/bcftools/htslib 1.24, not the historic bundled installers; differences isolate program logic, not binary versions.

cases.v44_2: Interior marker of a forward chain block: one-based position passed to pyliftover; the origin errors cancel.
Last base of a chain block: the one-based position falls outside the block in pyliftover's zero-based API, so the marker is dropped.
cases.current: Converted to zero-based and back: lifted to the block's last hg19 base.

cases.v44_2: Last base of a chain gap: read as the next block's first base and written at that block's first hg19 coordinate.
cases.current: Not lifted: the base has no hg19 placement, so the marker is a no-call.

cases.v44_2: Inverted block: hit strand ignored (genotype not complemented) and the origin error no longer cancels (two bases off).
cases.current: Correct hg19 coordinate; genotype complemented and written in allele order.

cases.v44_2: Two chain placements: the first hit is written.
cases.current: Ambiguous placement rejected: no hg19 row, so the marker is a no-call.

cases.v44_2: 3-read marker called: no depth or GQ gate.
cases.current: No-call with reason low_dp (default minimum depth 10, GQ 20). More no-calls on low-coverage input are intended, not an accuracy ranking.

cases.v44_2: Marker supported only by MAPQ 5 reads called: no mapping-quality floor.
cases.current: No-call with reason low_mapq (reads below MAPQ 10 are ignored).

cases.v44_2: The released v8 ploidy.txt makes every contig diploid, so a male's non-PAR X marker with mixed reads is called heterozygous.
cases.current: Male non-PAR X is called haploid from the sample's sex and build.

cases.v44_2: All-diploid calling has no sex gate: reads on chrY in a female sample are called.
cases.current: Female chrY markers are no-calls; female X is diploid.

cases.v44_2: Template markers absent from the CombinedKit are written as no-calls (--, Ancestry 00), not as reference.
cases.current: Same default; reference filling is an explicit VCF-input opt-in.

cases.v44_2: MT markers are lifted through the hg38->hg19 chain like nuclear ones, projecting rCRS positions onto hg19's Yoruba chrM.
cases.current: rCRS MT positions are kept unchanged on export (#1042, rCRS mtDNA export).

cases.v44_2: Haploid mtDNA VCF (bcftools call --ploidy 1 -mv -P 0) calls a 30x homoplasmic variant.
cases.current: extract mito-vcf calls the same variant and genotype.

cases.v44_2: A 2-read mtDNA variant is emitted: no depth gate.
cases.current: extract mito-vcf also emits it; filter low-depth calls downstream.

cases.v44_2: mt haplogroup classification refuses Yoruba-mtDNA (hg19 chrM) alignments.
cases.current: lineage mt-haplogroup refuses or warns on Yoruba mtDNA.

cases.v44_2: Y and Y+MT BAMs on chr-named GRCh38 keep chrY_KI270740v1_random reads.
cases.current: extract ydna-bam / y-mt-extract keep the main chrY (and chrM) contigs only.

cases.v44_2: Targeted Y VCF on builds 19/37/38, annotated with yBrowse ID, HG and ISOGG.
cases.current: extract ydna-vcf --ybrowse is GRCh38-only and rejects GRCh37/T2T.

cases.v44_2: idxstats mapped and unmapped columns are summed per contig, so unmapped reads placed beside their mates count as mapped.
cases.current: info --detailed keeps placed-unmapped reads out of the mapped count.

cases.v44_2: The InDel VCF action passes mpileup -I (skip indels) and call -V snps, so it writes no indels.
cases.current: vcf indel calls and normalises the indel.

completed_fixes.title: rCRS mtDNA markers kept off the hg38->hg19 (Yoruba chrM) chain on export
Microarray reuse identity includes effective sex/ploidy, template/chain identity and quality settings

public.description: Public-data comparison retained from #994 (v4 before/after): released v44.2 functions and the CLI on the same reads, targets, ploidy, chain and 23andMe V3 template. Fetch with scripts/v4_differential_corpus.py fetch --download; run offline with its public subcommand.
public.sample: HG00096 (1000 Genomes, open access, NYGC high-coverage GRCh38)
public.records_digest: SHA-256 of `samtools view` output (records only, no header)

downsample.origin: samtools 1.24 view --subsample 0.1 --subsample-seed 994 on linux-x86_64 (#994 run). The same command keeps different reads on macOS arm64, so the corpus selects the recorded read names instead.

23andme_v3.note: 57 observed chip calls, not 959,286 independent concordant genotypes; other rows are no-calls outside the slice.

low_depth.note: A quality-policy difference, not an accuracy ranking: neither side was truth-checked.

stats.note: 20 unmapped reads placed beside their mates.

recorded_run.timing_note: Single warm runs on one leased core; descriptive only, not a speed claim.
